description: The pie chart represents the distribution of two types of tasks in a study on generative AI's use in journalism. There are two slices in the chart. The first slice, representing "Article generation," is colored red and accounts for 83.2% of the tasks. The second slice, representing "Headline generation," is colored yellow and accounts for 16.8% of the tasks. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
